paper_metadata.title: Improving mechanical properties of an FCC high-entropy alloy by γ′ and B2 precipitates strengthening

evidence.quote: Improving mechanical properties of an FCC high-entropy alloy by γ′ and B2 precipitates strengthening
A new (FeCoNi) 81 Cr 9Al 8Ti 1Nb 1 HEA strengthened by combining γ′ with B2 phases was designed and fabricated by melting and a ging treatment.
A new (FeCoNi) 81 Cr 9Al 8Ti 1Nb 1 HEA with γ′ and B2 phases was fabricated, which exhibits an outstanding balanced strength and ductility at room and elevated temperatures.

The one-step aged (S1) alloy shows a moderate improvement in str ength but with a slight loss of elongation compared to the C alloy.
For two-step aged (S2) alloy, the YS and UTS are 863 and 1285 MPa, respectively, whilst the elongation still remains at a respectable value of 28 %.

prepared using a vacuum arc melting furnace from pure metals (> 99.9 wt.%) under a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere. The button alloys were re-melted at least five times
the arc-melted button alloys were casted to a rectangular ingot using a water-cooled copper mold
the ingots were homogenized at 1190 ℃ for 6 h followed by water-cooling (WC)
the homogenized ingot was cold-rolled with 80 % reduction in thickness
then annealed at 1100 ℃ for 1 h followed by water-cooling
aging at 845 ℃ for 4 h and air-cooling (845 ℃/4 h, AC)
